mods.name: Orbital Identity Pack+
mods.description:
New update is out! I've added a bunch of high-quality logos for your builds, including transparent versions for better blending.

Added Logos:
PhilSA (Philippine Space Agency)
SpaceX (Falcon 9, Dragon, Starlink, Polaris Dawn) - Vertical & Horizontal
Airbus Defence & Space - New variants
US Space Force - Updated logos
Roscosmos
ISS (International Space Station)

Improvements:
Better resolution for large parts (up to 2030px).
Added Black, White, and Blue SpaceX variants for different tank colors.
Fixed transparency on several decals.
